# Value Creation UAE

> > Luxury pre-owned watch marketplace specializing in Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, and Richard Mille timepieces in Dubai and the UAE.

Value Creation UAE is a premium luxury watch reseller offering authenticated pre-owned timepieces from the world's most prestigious brands. The company operates in Dubai with shipping throughout the UAE via major couriers including FedEx, UPS, DHL, Aramex, Emirates Post, and Star-Shipping Courier.
